description: This file defines the API for computing CRC32C checksums, including classes, functions, and utilities for CRC calculations and manipulations, used within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: crc32c_t
classes.description: A strongly-typed class representing CRC32C checksum values with limited operators for safety.

methods.name: ComputeCrc32c
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32C checksum of a given string buffer.

methods.name: ExtendCrc32c
methods.description: Extends an existing CRC32C checksum with additional data.

methods.name: ExtendCrc32cByZeroes
methods.description: Extends a CRC32C checksum by appending zero bytes.

methods.name: MemcpyCrc32c
methods.description: Copies data between buffers while computing the CRC32C checksum of the copied data.

methods.name: ConcatCrc32c
methods.description: Concatenates two CRC32C checksums into one, representing the combined data.

methods.name: RemoveCrc32cPrefix
methods.description: Removes a prefix from a buffer and computes the resulting CRC32C.

methods.name: RemoveCrc32cSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix from a buffer and computes the resulting CRC32C.
